SourceProxy.label: Crop
SourceProxy.name: ImageClip

Documentation.long_help: Efficiently extract an area/volume of interest from a 2-d image or 3-d volume.

SourceProxy.Documentation: The Crop filter extracts an area/volume of interest from a 2D image or a 3D volume by allowing the user to specify the minimum and maximum extents of each dimension of the data. Both the input and output of this filter are uniform rectilinear data.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the input to the Crop filter.

IntVectorProperty.name: OutputWholeExtent
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This property gives the minimum and maximum point index (extent) in each dimension for the output dataset.

Documentation.long_help: This filter generate a color based image data based on a selected data scalar
Documentation.short_help: This filter generate a color based image data based on a selected data scalar

StringVectorProperty.label: Color By
StringVectorProperty.name: SelectInputScalars
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the name of the scalar array from which we will color by.

SourceProxy.label: Image Shrink
SourceProxy.name: ImageShrink

Documentation.long_help: Reduce the size of an image/volume by subsampling.

SourceProxy.Documentation: The Image Shrink filter reduces the size of an image/volume dataset by subsampling it (i.e., extracting every nth pixel/voxel in integer multiples). The subsampling rate can be set separately for each dimension of the image/volume.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the input to the Image Shrink filter.

IntVectorProperty.name: ShrinkFactors
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The value of this property indicates the amount by which to shrink along each axis.

IntVectorProperty.name: Averaging
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If the value of this property is 1, an average of neighborhood scalar values will be used as the output scalar value for each output point. If its value is 0, only subsampling will be performed, and the original scalar values at the points will be retained.

SourceProxy.label: Image Binary Threshold
SourceProxy.name: ImageBinaryThreshold
SourceProxy.Documentation: Image Binary Threshold is an image thresholding algorithm that allows users to replace pixel data by comparing them with 2 thresholds. To control the output of the filter, "Replace In" and "Replace Out" can be set to specify whether to use "In Value" and "Out Value" respectively to replace the input value. For example, if "Replace In" is set to 0, output pixels that are supposed to be "In Value" will not be replaced and will keep it's original input value.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: LowerThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Set the value of the upper threshold.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: UpperThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Set the value of the lower threshold.

IntVectorProperty.name: ReplaceIn
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Set whether or not the filter has to replace the values that are inside the lower and upper threshold bounds

DoubleVectorProperty.name: InValue
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Set the value that will replace data inside the lower and upper threshold bounds.

IntVectorProperty.name: ReplaceOut
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Set whether or not the filter has to replace the values that are outside the lower and upper threshold bounds

DoubleVectorProperty.name: OutValue
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Set the value that will replace data outside the lower and upper threshold bounds.
